$description: The twenty mysteries of the Rosary. Scripture refs are OSIS ranges; meditations are original writing. `beads` are ten verse refs (content.db keys) read one per Hail Mary, a Scriptural Rosary.

mysteries.title: The Annunciation
mysteries.meditation: Gabriel brings God's invitation, and Mary answers with her whole life: let it be done to me.

mysteries.title: The Visitation
mysteries.meditation: Mary hurries to help Elizabeth, and the child in Elizabeth's womb leaps for joy.

mysteries.title: The Nativity
mysteries.meditation: The Son of God is born in a stable, and the first to hear the news are shepherds.

mysteries.title: The Presentation in the Temple
mysteries.meditation: Simeon takes the child in his arms and knows he has seen the salvation God promised.

mysteries.title: The Finding in the Temple
mysteries.meditation: After three days of searching, Mary and Joseph find Jesus in his Father's house.

mysteries.title: The Baptism of the Lord
mysteries.meditation: The heavens open over the Jordan and the Father calls Jesus his beloved Son.

mysteries.title: The Wedding at Cana
mysteries.meditation: Mary notices what is missing and tells the servants: do whatever he tells you.

mysteries.title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom
mysteries.meditation: Jesus announces that the kingdom of God is at hand and calls everyone to repent and believe.

mysteries.title: The Transfiguration
mysteries.meditation: On the mountain the disciples glimpse Jesus' glory and hear the Father say: listen to him.

mysteries.title: The Institution of the Eucharist
mysteries.meditation: At the Last Supper Jesus gives himself to us: this is my body, given for you.

mysteries.title: The Agony in the Garden
mysteries.meditation: In Gethsemane Jesus prays in anguish and still says to the Father: your will be done.

mysteries.title: The Scourging at the Pillar
mysteries.meditation: Jesus bears the scourging in silence, carrying the weight of our sins.

mysteries.title: The Crowning with Thorns
mysteries.meditation: The soldiers mock the true King with a crown of thorns, and he does not strike back.

mysteries.title: The Carrying of the Cross
mysteries.meditation: Simon of Cyrene helps Jesus carry the cross along the road to Calvary.

mysteries.title: The Crucifixion
mysteries.meditation: Jesus forgives his executioners and commends his spirit into the Father's hands.

mysteries.title: The Resurrection
mysteries.meditation: The tomb is empty. He is not here; he has been raised, just as he said.

mysteries.title: The Ascension
mysteries.meditation: Jesus returns to the Father and promises the Spirit, sending the disciples to the ends of the earth.

mysteries.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
mysteries.meditation: At Pentecost the Spirit comes like wind and fire, and the frightened disciples speak boldly.

mysteries.title: The Assumption of Mary
mysteries.meditation: At the end of her earthly life Mary is taken up, body and soul, into heavenly glory.

mysteries.title: The Coronation of Mary
mysteries.meditation: Mary is honored as Queen of heaven and earth, and she still points us to her Son.
